newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: UAE to start Dubai-Baku air service from June 2.
newsitem.headline: UAE to start Dubai-Baku air service from June 2.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates' international carrier Emirates Airline will begin scheduled thrice-weekly flights between Dubai and Baku, the capital of Azerbaijan, the company said in a press statement on Monday.
Quoting Shoaib Khoory, the airline's senior general manager of commercial operations, it said the airline would begin the first regular flights to destinations in the former Soviet Union from June 2.
"We will operate a long-range A-300-600R jet with departure from Baku on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays," Khoory said.
He said that passengers would have a convenient connection in Dubai airport for destinations to London, Nairobi, Bombay and South East Asia.

Khoory said Emirates Sky Cargo, the airline's freight division, looked set to develop the air cargo business between Baku and Dubai, using a container and cargo capacity of 12,000 kg available on A-300-600R aircraft.
